comments.author: Xiao Wei
comments.body: There are two discoveries to be made: Baltic sturgeon in (you guessed it) the Baltic (the extreme eastern end of the Gulf of Finland), and the beluga in the Black Sea. If you're farming for caviar, I recommend the Black Sea. I caught one Baltic sturgeon fairly quickly, but his friends all stayed away, whereas in the Black Sea (SE corner by the landing area), I caught an average of 1/day over a 30-day period.
